o.norm: Tests that {@link ByteOrderMark#getCharsetName()} can be loaded as a {@link java.nio.charset.Charset} as advertised.

i.norm: Verifies that every predefined {@link ByteOrderMark} constant carries a charset name that is recognised by the JVM. {@link Charset#forName(String)} returns a non-null {@link Charset} on success and throws {@link java.nio.charset.UnsupportedCharsetException} on failure, so a non-null result proves the name is valid.
